tldr: North Node in gemini: growth through curiosity, listening, questions, and local truth.
body: This nodal axis asks the person to develop curiosity, listening, questions, and local truth. The South Node in sagittarius shows the familiar route: certainty, preaching, overgeneralizing, and using belief to avoid details. The work is not to reject the South Node completely, but to stop letting it run automatically. The North Node becomes stronger through repeated, conscious choices to stay teachable even when you know a lot.
business: Growth accelerates when the person practices curiosity, listening, questions, and local truth in real decisions, relationships, work, and daily habits.
shadow: Under stress, the South Node in sagittarius can pull the person back into certainty, preaching, overgeneralizing, and using belief to avoid details.
policy: Read as a nodal axis: North Node sign names the growth medicine; South Node sign names the familiar pattern. Do not treat either node as a planet or deterministic fate.
